response.justification: Bogdan brings exceptional domain expertise in geospatial systems through his GISCollective platform and years of GIS work—a rare and highly valuable skill set for routing tile development. His senior-level experience demonstrates strong engineering fundamentals and learning agility across multiple languages. However, there is a critical gap: his most recent C++ work was over 10 years ago at National Instruments, and the past 5+ years have focused on TypeScript/Node.js. Given that modern C++ is the primary requirement, his current skillset presents substantial risk, though his proven ability to master new technologies and rare domain knowledge warrant a conversation about C++ readiness.
strengths: Deep geospatial/GIS expertise through founding GISCollective and Green Map platforms; directly familiar with map data systems and geo-data pipelines
Senior-level engineer with demonstrated ability to learn multiple programming languages and technical domains; currently Staff Software Engineer optimizing full-stack solutions
Proven experience optimizing high-throughput systems and data pipelines; at Dunnhumby handled millions of HTTP requests/second with low-latency, real-time data processing
concerns: Significant C++ gap: last substantial C++ work was 10+ years ago (National Instruments, 2014-2015); primary recent experience is TypeScript and Node.js, not the required modern C++
Limited demonstrated expertise in distributed systems concepts; no clear evidence of working with fault tolerance, consistency guarantees, or service discovery patterns at scale
No documented experience building navigation guidance or routing systems; prior GIS work focused on data collection and mapping rather than production navigation pipelines
